title: 第421章 四只阴灵王第420章 楚枫你这个浑蛋
content_zh:
第一卷第421章四只阴灵王！
玲珑颜同样僵在原地，帷帽下的眼眸中翻涌着难以置信的震惊之色。
阴冥之地的空间极为稳固，这里曾是上古战场，陨落在此的强者不计其数，残存的法则之力将这片空间加固到了极其恐怖的程度。
想要遁空而行绝不是一件容易的事，至少需要仙帝境的修为才能做到。
可她怎么也没想到，那个金仙境的男人竟然借用了她的力量做到了，而且做到了之后，不带她一起走。
“我从未见过如此厚颜无耻之人！”
她连那个男人的名字都不知道，就被他坑了两次。
然而两人骂归骂，也不得不面对眼前两只扑过来的阴灵王。
玄刹姬冷哼一声，将满腔怒火都发泄在了这只不长眼的阴灵王身上。
“罗刹镇天诀！”
她周身仙尊巅峰的魔光冲天而起，在她身后凝聚成一尊高达百丈的罗刹女王法相。
那法相通体暗红，手持一柄巨大的魔剑虚影。
她一剑斩出，百丈剑罡如同九天血河倒泻般与阴灵王的巨爪狠狠撞在一起。
另外一只阴灵王则朝玲珑颜扑来，口中喷出三道灰黑阴气凝聚的长矛。
玲珑颜咬牙催动玄幽镇魂珠，九颗魂珠同时亮起光芒，在她身前凝聚成一面巨大的光盾。
三根阴气长矛撞在光盾上发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣，光盾剧烈震颤却勉强挡住了这一击。
然而她的面色更加苍白了几分，神魂创伤未愈，精神力又被楚枫抽走了一部分，每撑一息都让她识海中的剧痛加剧一分。
玄刹姬被震退数十丈才勉强稳住身形，玲珑颜更是被冲击波震得连退百丈。
然而就在两人想要拼尽全力脱身之时，一股更加阴冷的威压从地底深处轰然爆发。
两人同时低头，瞳孔皱缩。

第三只阴灵王！
那阴灵王体型比前两只更加庞大，散发出的威压赫然已接近仙圣中期。
玄刹姬面色骤变，咬牙吐出一个字。
“跑！”
血影遁！
她的身形化作一道血色流光，硬生生从两只阴灵王的包夹之中撕开一道空间裂缝，转瞬便消失在裂缝之中。
两只阴灵王的利爪从她方才所在的位置交叉斩过，却只抓到了一片残影。
玲珑颜一咬牙，猛地将手中玄幽镇魂珠朝地面狠狠掷去，九颗魂珠同时炸裂，化作光幕将她的身形笼罩其中。
幽魂解体遁！
她的身形在光幕中骤然崩散成九道幽光，朝九个不同的方向激射而去。
这种遁术会将自身神魂分裂成九份，虽消耗极大却极难拦截。
八道幽光被阴灵王追上撕碎，但最后一道幽光成功穿过了阴灵王利爪的缝隙，消失在阴冥之地的天穹尽头。
数千里外，一道血色裂缝骤然裂开，玄刹姬踉跄着跌出裂缝，面色惨白如纸，唇角挂着一缕血痕。
她回头望了一眼来时的方向，咬牙切齿地低吼。
“楚枫，本王绝不会放过你！”
另一边，数千里外的一处荒废祭坛上，最后那道幽光凝聚成玲珑颜的身影。
她瘫坐在祭坛边缘，帷帽下的呼吸急促到了极点。
“浑蛋……最好别让本姑娘再碰到你！”
万里之外。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 421 Four Yin Spirit Kings!
Linglongyan also froze on the spot, her eyes under the curtain filled with unbelievable shock.
The space in the Land of Yin is extremely stable. It was once an ancient battlefield, and countless strong men fell here. The remaining power of the law has strengthened this space to an extremely terrifying level.
It is by no means an easy task to escape through the air, and it requires at least the cultivation of the Immortal Emperor Realm to do it.
But she never expected that the man from the Golden Fairyland would actually borrow her power to do it, and after he did it, he would not take her with him.
"I have never seen such a shameless person!"
She didn't even know the man's name, but he had tricked her twice.
However, the two of them scolded each other and had to face the two Yin Spirit Kings rushing towards them.
Xuan Chaji snorted coldly and vented all her anger on the eyeless Yin Spirit King.
"Rakshasa Heaven-Suppressing Technique!"
The magic light from the peak of the Immortal Lord around her soared into the sky, condensing behind her into a hundred-foot-tall Rakshasa Queen.
The dharma-linked body was dark red, and it was holding a huge demon sword.
She slashed out with her sword, and the hundred-foot-long sword collided with the Yinling King's giant claw like a river of blood pouring out from the sky.
Another Yin Spirit King rushed towards Linglong Yan, spitting out three spears condensed with gray and black Yin Qi from its mouth.
Linglongyan gritted her teeth and activated the Xuanyou Soul Suppressing Pearl. The nine soul pearls lit up at the same time, condensing into a huge light shield in front of her.
The three Yin Qi spears hit the light shield with a deafening roar. The light shield shook violently but barely blocked the blow.
However, her complexion became even paler. The trauma to her soul had not yet healed, and part of her mental power was drained away by Chu Feng. Every breath she took made the severe pain in her sea of ​​consciousness intensify.
Xuan Chaji was knocked back dozens of feet before she could barely stabilize her figure, and Linglong Yan was even knocked back hundreds of feet by the shock wave.
However, just when the two of them tried their best to escape, an even colder pressure suddenly erupted from deep underground.
The two of them lowered their heads at the same time, their pupils shrinking.
The third Yinling King!
The Yin Spirit King was larger than the previous two, and the pressure it exuded was approaching the middle stage of the Immortal Saint.
Xuan Cha Ji's complexion suddenly changed, she gritted her teeth and uttered one word.
"Run!"
Blood Shadow Escape!
Her body turned into a bloody stream of light, tearing open a space crack from the two Yin Spirit Kings, and disappeared into the crack in an instant.
The sharp claws of the two Yin Spirit Kings crossed over where she was just now, but only caught an afterimage.
Linglongyan gritted her teeth and threw the Xuanyou Soul Suppressing Pearl in her hand towards the ground. The nine soul pearls exploded at the same time, turning into a light curtain and covering her figure.
The ghost disintegrates and escapes!
Her figure suddenly disintegrated into nine rays of light in the light curtain, shooting in nine different directions.
This escape technique will split one's own soul into nine parts. Although it consumes a lot of energy, it is extremely difficult to intercept.
The eight rays of light were chased and torn apart by the Yin Spirit King, but the last ray of light successfully passed through the gap in the Yin Spirit King's claws and disappeared at the end of the sky in the Land of Yin.
Thousands of miles away, a bloody crack suddenly opened, and Xuan Shaji stumbled out of the crack, her face as pale as paper, and a trace of blood hanging from the corner of her lips.
She looked back in the direction she came from and growled through gritted teeth.
"Chu Feng, I will never let you go!"
On the other side, on an abandoned altar thousands of miles away, the last dim light condensed into an exquisite figure.
She slumped down on the edge of the altar, her breathing quickening under the curtain.
"Asshole...it's best not to let this girl touch you again!"
Thousands of miles away.
